common.name: Name
components.colorMode.label: Colour mode
components.currency.label: Currency
components.documentLanguages.second.help: For a bilingual sheet: each label in both.

components.errorBoundary.updated: The app was updated while this tab was open. Reload to pick up the new version — nothing is lost.

inventory.actions.label: Actions for {sku} at {location}
inventory.history.introLot: Every movement of lot {lot}, newest first. Nothing here can be edited or removed — a correction is another movement that says so.
inventory.history.introVariant: Every movement of {sku}, newest first. Nothing here can be edited or removed — a correction is another movement that says so.
inventory.history.title: History for {sku}
inventory.leavesOnly: Only locations that hold stock directly are listed.
inventory.lot.changesEverywhere: This changes the lot everywhere, not only the units at {location}.
inventory.lot.codeEditable: Nobody printed this code, so a typo can be corrected here.
inventory.lot.codePrinted: Printed on the boxes, so it cannot be renamed. Move the stock to the correct lot instead.
inventory.lot.expires.help: Leave blank if it does not expire.
inventory.lot.expires.helpReceive: Leave blank if it does not expire. Ignored if this lot already exists.
inventory.lot.number.help: As printed on the box. Receiving the same lot again adds to it.
inventory.lot.title: Lot {code}
inventory.move.adjust.title: Correct the count
inventory.move.difference.help: How many {unit} out, not the new total.
inventory.move.givenTo.help: Optional. Recorded so a recall can find it.
inventory.move.heldBack: {location} is marked not available, so nothing can be sent from it. Move the stock to an available location first.
inventory.move.sample.title: Send a sample
inventory.move.ship.title: Ship out
inventory.move.transfer.title: Move to another location
inventory.move.whatHappened.help: Whoever reads this in six months was not there.
inventory.movements.empty: Nothing has moved yet. Receiving stock is what puts the first row here.
inventory.movements.intro: Every quantity change, newest first. Movements are never edited or removed — a mistake is corrected by another movement.
inventory.needsLocation: Add a location before receiving stock. Stock sits in the places that contain nothing else — a bin, a shelf, or a whole warehouse if you have not divided it up yet.
inventory.promised.intro: Across every location stock can be sent from. Held stock is for a confirmed sale, earliest confirmed first; free stock can be promised, sampled or used in production.
inventory.promised.title: Promised to customers
inventory.receive.noProducts: No products yet. Add one on the Products screen — stock is counted against a variant, so there has to be something to count.
inventory.search.help: Anywhere in the SKU, the product name or the lot code.
inventory.trace.cameFrom.empty: No receipt or production is recorded for this lot. It may have been counted into stock by a correction.
inventory.trace.lotCode.help: Any part of the code works — the batch number is usually enough. Press Enter to search.
inventory.trace.madeFrom.empty: Not made in a run here — received, not produced.
inventory.trace.receivedBy.empty: Nothing from this lot has left the business.
inventory.trace.receivedBy.intro: This lot and everything made from it: the list a recall has to reach.
inventory.trace.receivedNoOrder: Received with no order on record
inventory.trace.title: Trace a lot
inventory.trace.unknownRecipients: Some left with no recipient on record — shipped without an order, or sampled without a name. They are listed below with no partner.
inventory.trace.whereNow.empty: None of this lot is on hand anywhere.
language.label: Language
layout.notifications.title: Notifications
layout.unverified.message: Confirm your email address to secure your account.
locations.code.help: What is on the label — H5, A-01-03. Unique within its parent.
locations.create.leavesHoldStock: Stock sits in the places that contain nothing else. A single room is a location in its own right — add bins inside it later if you need them.
locations.create.parentStopsHolding: {name} will stop holding stock directly. Anything already there has to move into a child location first.
locations.create.title: Add a location
locations.edit.inside.help: Its own descendants are not listed — moving a location inside itself would detach the subtree.
locations.edit.title: Edit {name}
locations.empty: No locations yet. Start with a site — a building or an address. You can add zones, aisles, and bins inside it later, or leave it as one room.
locations.type.help: A label for reading, not a rule. Depth is not enforced.
orders.close.purchase: Some of what was ordered has not been received. Closing the order says nothing more is expected — the stock already received stays exactly as it is, and anything that turns up later can be received from the Inventory screen.
orders.close.sale: Some of what was ordered has not been shipped. Closing the order says nothing more will be sent — what has shipped stays exactly as it is, and anything sent later can be shipped from the Inventory screen.
orders.close.title: Close this order?
orders.closeLine.notice: The ordered quantity stays as it is. Nothing further will be expected, but the shortfall remains visible — otherwise a short delivery would look the same as an accurate one.
orders.closeLine.title: Stop expecting the rest
orders.closeLine.why.help: Discontinued, backordered indefinitely, ordered by mistake.
orders.create.isSample: This is a sample — price it at zero if it is free
orders.create.loadFailed: Could not load partners and products.
orders.direction.purchase.help: Stock arrives, and is received against this order.
orders.direction.sale.help: Stock leaves. Receiving does not apply to a sale.
orders.duplicate.advice: Fix the draft, confirm it, then cancel this one — that way nothing is lost if something goes wrong.
orders.duplicate.intro: A new draft for {partner}, with the same {count, plural, one {item} other {# items}} and quantities. This order is not changed.
orders.duplicate.notCopied: The reference and expected date are not copied. A supplier's PO number belongs to the order it was issued against.
orders.duplicate.reference.optional: Optional — you can add it later.
orders.duplicate.reference.used: The original used {reference}. The copy needs its own.
orders.duplicate.title: Duplicate this order
orders.edit.fixed: The supplier and direction cannot change — every line and every receipt is recorded against them. Duplicate the order instead.
orders.edit.reference.help: The supplier's PO number, or your own. Shown in the orders list.
orders.edit.title: Edit order
orders.empty.open: Nothing open. Raising an order records what you asked a partner for — receiving against it is what puts the stock on a shelf.
orders.filter.label: Show
orders.lines.catalogueFailed: Could not load the catalogue. Close and try again.
orders.lines.confirmedNotice: This order has been confirmed. Changing the quantity or price amends what was agreed with the supplier.
orders.lines.draftPurchase: Nothing can be received against a draft. Confirming is what says this order is real.
orders.lines.draftSale: Nothing can be shipped against a draft. Confirming is what says this order is real.
orders.lines.heldTooltip: {held} held for this order; the rest waits for stock
orders.lines.noPrices: No prices recorded on this order
orders.lines.partialTotal: Some lines have no price — this is not the full total
orders.lines.price.help: Optional. Left blank, the order's price list supplies it when there is one.
orders.lines.price.keep: Leave blank to keep the current price.
orders.lines.returnsNote: Returns don't reopen an item. To send replacements, raise a new sale.
orders.theirReference.help: Their number for this order, not ours. Optional.
partners.address.label: Label
partners.address.label.help: What you would call it out loud — Head office, Dock 3.
partners.addresses.empty: No addresses yet. An order needs somewhere to ship to.
partners.code.help: Your own reference — a supplier number, a customer code. Unique within your organization if you use one.
partners.contact.phone.help: An email or a phone — at least one.
partners.contact.role.help: In their words — Accounts payable, Warehouse manager.
partners.contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Someone has to answer when an order is late.
partners.create.oneList: One list for both sides of the trade. There is nothing to pick here — whether this partner is a supplier or a customer follows from the orders you raise against them.
partners.create.title: Add a partner
partners.documentLanguages.notice: Packing slips, invoices and credit notes for this partner, from the next one made. Those already made keep their languages.
partners.documentLanguages.title: Document languages
partners.edit.title: Edit {name}
partners.empty: No partners yet. Add the firms you buy from and sell to — an order needs one before it can be raised. The same partner can be both.
partners.name.help: Names are not unique — two branches of one company are two partners.
partners.taxId.help: VAT, GST, EIN — whatever applies. Stored as typed, never validated.
products.create.title: Add a product
products.discontinuedNotice: This product is discontinued. Its variants keep their own status, so reactivating restores each to what it was.
products.sku.help: Typed, not generated — this is the code on the label.
products.tracksLots.fixed: Lot tracking cannot be changed later.
products.translations.descriptionNeedsNa: A description in {language} needs a name in {language} too.
products.translations.intro: Where a language is left blank, documents in it print the base name, {name}.
products.translations.none: None yet: every document prints the name above.
products.translations.title: Names in other languages
products.variant.unitsPerCase.help: How many of this variant ship in one case.
products.variation.helpOptional: Optional. 60ct, Large, Blue — leave blank if there is only one.
